explanation: That silhouette, a boy and E.T. on a bike against a full Moon, became the logo of Amblin Entertainment, the production company Steven Spielberg co-founded.

claims.text: In E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial (1982), Elliott and E.T. fly on a bicycle across the face of the Moon.
Elliott does not ride a skateboard, a motorbike or a go-kart in that scene.
The image of the flying bicycle silhouetted against the Moon became the logo of Amblin Entertainment.
Steven Spielberg co-founded the production company Amblin Entertainment.
